course.title: System Development Project
course.department: Department of Computer Science and Engineering

content.value: A service facility consists of one-server who can serve an average of 2 customers per hour (service times are exponential). An average of 3 customers per hour arrive at the facility (exponential inter-arrival times). The system capacity is 3 customers. Find the followings:
i) On the average, how many potential customers enter the system each hour?
ii) What is the probability that the server will be busy?

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 3rd Year 2nd Term Regular Examination, 2023
